title: Skin Care for Ahmedabad Weather: A Routine for Hot, Dry Summers and Mild Winters
ex: Very hot summers, a short monsoon, dry winters, hard water, garba nights and Uttarayan terraces: a simple skin care routine for people living in Ahmedabad.
rt: Skin Care for Ahmedabad Weather: Heat and Dry Air | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Ahmedabad weather: daily sunscreen, light moisture for hot dry air, hard water tips, garba nights, Uttarayan terrace days and mild winters.
quick: Ahmedabad is hot and semi-arid, so skin can be oily on the forehead and tight on the cheeks at the same time. A gentle face wash, a light moisturiser on damp skin, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a pea-sized night cream suit most people.
facts: Ahmedabad has a hot semi-arid climate
Summers (March to June) are very hot with harsh sun
The monsoon (July to September) is short and humid
Winters are mild, dry and sunny
